scope: separate early parking precision reward ablation; not full R7, not replay capacity study, not final control acceptance

current_window.runtime_effective_finish: min(fixed finish timestamp, verified lease expiration minus90min)

all_required: 13 static reward tests bound to source SHA and logs
GPU reward and counters/restore smoke tests passed
four-lane aggregate throughput and evaluation cost conservatively bound
complete paired48 experiment plus all endpoint evaluation plus archive fits verified deadline with margin
future_execution_gate.formula: 1.20 * max(8100, T_train_p95 + T_startups + T_30_endpoint_cases_p75 + T_checkpoint_readback + T_archive + T_one_technical_retry)

parent.inherit: modules targets optimizers normalizers and native learned std; fresh replay/counters/fork RNG, new simulator

common_training_environment.existing_parking_body_velocity_formula: retain exact R6 term including original mask (previous implementation norm(command_xy)<.05 and abs(command_wz)<.05), body vx^2+vy^2+.25*wz^2; validate actual source, do not rewrite
common_training_environment.other_rewards_and_actions: unchanged from actual R6 training config, not from evaluation defaults

directions.meaning: same actual baseline plus precision term

algorithm.representation: continue existing encoder/projector and both normalizer updates; freeze during evaluation

new_precision_term.total_reward: original complete R6 reward INCLUDING existing -8 parking term + extra_reward

evaluation.pairing: actual physical initial-state fingerprint per seed across parent/all arms/D,S; separate action+observation RNG IDs
evaluation.S_std: native learned checkpoint std, no rescaling

decision.interpretation: exploratory short-budget effect only; no promotion, no acceptance, no replay-capacity claim
promising_requires_all: both P1 forks survive6/6 and preserve motion competence6/6
P1 worst-fork standard pass count >= P0 worst-fork count
P1 overall pass >= P0 overall pass
promising_requires_any: P1 worst-fork passes at least one more case of6 than P0
P1 worst-fork P <= .8*P0 AND <=frozen parent P; finite complete positive denominator required
decision.future_action_if_promising: report as hypothesis for separately budgeted independent test, do not continue automatically
decision.if_no_signal: no_progress_short_budget, not proof precision reward is useless

stop_conditions.current_window: do not start formal learning; record budget_blocked
stop_conditions.preflight_one_failure: stop and archive actual error; do not spend remaining lease debugging repeatedly
formal_only_future_window: unexpected Critic/Actor/alpha/target update skips or count mismatch
auxiliary skip ratio>.01 with causes logged
free disk<10GiB orderly save; no new jobs below12GiB
stop_conditions.actual_fall: valid failed evaluation, do not retry or substitute seed
stop_conditions.cannot_finish_all_four_same_L48: incomplete/budget_stopped, do not rank unequal budgets as complete trial

delivery: source commit, hashes and 13 static-test logs or explicit missing status
GPU smoke report passed/failed/not_run with exit codes and zero/actual physical steps
budget table actual remaining time, forecast components and go/no-go decision
frozen baseline and all arm config JSON/YAML
if future executed: L48 four model files and latest four full-resume files, attempted/succeeded/skipped updates
all30 endpoint raw trajectories, per-case failures and paired metrics if executed
external backup of parent/checkpoints/code/raw evidence with checksum manifest; archive even when budget_blocked
